info.title: DriveCore Backend API
info.description: DriveCore API through all defined M10–M16.5 backend requirements: messaging, reporting, statistics, invitation-only accounts, fleet controls, credit approvals, full accounting, SRS roles, CRM, TOTP and digital fleet/procurement. M17 printing/barcodes and M18 GPS remain undefined placeholders. Company/branch scope applies throughout. Password rotation and privileged TOTP enrollment gates return 403 until completed.

post.summary: Create document
post.description: Requires documents.manage. entity_type and entity_id must be supplied together, or both omitted/null. Target must be accessible in the exact company and branch. Only vehicle/customer/reservation/rental targets exist in M6; quotation/invoice uploads return 422 until those modules are implemented. Drivers may upload only against assigned rentals; unrelated/unlinked documents are denied. Multipart identifiers are returned as JSON integers.

patch.summary: Update user access in a company
patch.description: Requires users.manage and whole-company access. company_id is required in JSON. Only role, branch_id and is_active may change. Self access changes return 409. Company administrators cannot change global roles or activation for multi-company users (409), or manage platform accounts (404). Platform administrators may change global access for multi-company users. Deactivation revokes personal access tokens; existing sessions are denied by active-account middleware. Role assignments are global in this version.

InvitationAcceptInput.description: Existing accounts supply their current password. New accounts also supply name and password confirmation. Existing accounts retain compatible global roles. TOTP-enabled existing accounts receive a challenge instead of a full session.

password.description: At least one letter and one digit; cannot reuse current password.

TwoFactorChallengeInput.description: Supply either code or recovery_code. Challenge expires in five minutes and is single-use; recovery codes are single-use.

signature_data_url.description: PNG data URL; decoded PNG must be at most 150 KB.

x-integration-notes.settings_storage: Unit preferences and privileged 2FA policy extend the existing companies settings record. No separate company_settings table is introduced.
x-integration-notes.canonical_units: km, L, kg and L/100km; currency amounts are integer minor units.
x-integration-notes.mail: Configure FRONTEND_URL, MAIL_* and a working queue worker. Invitation tokens in queued notifications are encrypted.
x-integration-notes.roles: The catalog has 10 exact SRS roles plus driver and 4 legacy aliases. Existing multi-company users retain compatible global roles; platform administration is required for incompatible global access changes.
x-integration-notes.approval: No self approval. Configured SRS approver roles apply. Accepted decisions retain exact values, actor, notes and time; threshold-gated mutations consume decisions once.
x-integration-notes.deployment: Manual deployment remains separate from merge.
